learning_outcomes.text: Get acquainted with contemporary scientific and technical achievements in the sphere of the diploma project.
Get acquainted with the existing condition of the problem in the organization that suggested the diploma project topic.

syllabus_topics: Literature sources, patents, inventions related to the diploma project topic
Methods for theoretical and experimental investigations and their results
Laboratory equipment, measurement devices, tools patterns
Machines for mechanical treatment, casting, welding, plastic deformation and thermal treatment
Methodology for constructive and technological calculations
Software packages for solving engineering problems
teaching_methods: Work in mechanical and mechanical-mounting workshops
Work in constructive and technological offices or divisions of machine-building companies
assessment_rules: The assessment is an oral exam. The results from the practice are used in forming the literature reference of the diploma project and the development of its specific sections.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
